source_review.notes: Checked the active NASA-HDBK-1004 and NASA-HDBK-1009A standards records, the approved NASA-HDBK-1004 baseline, the formal OMG Systems Modeling API 1.0 specification, the W3C PROV-O Recommendation, and five official NIST program/publication records on digital-thread architecture, graph linking, manufacturing/inspection integration, and digital-twin relationships. All ten final URLs returned HTTP 200. Claims distinguish standards and official program findings from the chapter's engineering synthesis.

evidence: Reviewed the thread tuple over artifacts, links, identities, configurations, provenance, history and query context.
Reviewed the typed-link tuple over subject, predicate, object, endpoint configurations, effective time, record time, authority, provenance and quality/status.
Reviewed artifact-state, identity-resolution, path-health, effective-time and record-time notation.
Confirmed symbols are introduced before consequential use and the path-health tuple remains dimensional rather than being silently averaged.
notation_and_syntax.notes: The formalism is an engineering decision model, not a complete ontology or a theorem about arbitrary federated systems.

evidence: Executed digital-thread-metadata-fixture under python3 with exact output recorded in artifacts/snippets/SYSENG-059/report.json.
Confirmed six artifacts, seven links, six distinct lifecycle stages and one requirement.
Confirmed all six identities are unique and all seven link endpoints resolve.
Confirmed all seven predicates are in the declared vocabulary and all seven links have equal configuration labels.
Confirmed all six artifacts carry declared provenance, the requirement reaches an operated artifact, no artifacts are orphaned and no links are invalid.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The fixture is synthetic metadata evidence only. It does not inspect content, authenticate sources, establish temporal/access completeness, prove link truth or accept a product.

evidence: Confirmed a decision-supporting path requires resolved endpoints, semantically compatible predicates, compatible configurations/effectivities, appropriate authorities, reproducible transformations and sufficient query completeness.
Confirmed access denial, source outage, ambiguity, stale replicas and incomplete mapping lead to qualified partial or unknown results rather than false absence.
Confirmed effective-time and record-time selection answer different historical questions and correction appends history instead of erasing prior recorded knowledge.
Confirmed the evidence argument separates scope, resolution, traversal, configuration, provenance, temporal, completeness and content-assessment obligations.
Confirmed loss of decision-relevant context weakens or blocks a conclusion instead of strengthening it.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: No graph path, digest, signature, provenance statement or metadata fixture is elevated into proof of artifact truth or system fitness.

evidence: Challenged duplicate display names, namespace collision, rename, merge, split, alias, retirement, tombstone and identifier reuse.
Reviewed variant contamination, serial/lot effectivity, substitutions, deviations, as-designed/as-built divergence and historically impossible latest-version assemblies.
Reviewed late and corrected observations, missing time zones, source/index staleness, mutable history and known-at versus applies-at queries.
Reviewed source timeout, access denial, supplier opacity, partial federation, pagination, stale caches, event duplication/reordering/replay and source migration.
Reviewed generic predicates, invalid transitivity, unit/schema mismatches, mapping changes, null versus zero, derived-artifact staleness and irreproducible transformations.
Reviewed relationship/count/topology inference, mixed-classification aggregation, cache/export leakage, tampering, malicious mapped values and data-rights boundaries.
Reviewed misleading scalar health scores, missing critical evidence, unsupported AI-inferred links, digital-twin conflation and blockchain overclaims.
Reviewed all ten worked examples and five complete answers for assumptions, intermediate reasoning, evidence limits and bounded conclusions.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Production use still requires domain ontology, configuration-management, data/API/platform, cybersecurity, privacy/export/data-rights, supplier, records, assurance and decision-authority review appropriate to consequence.

evidence: Traced stable identity independent of name/location/tool and explicit authority by fact domain throughout definitions, mechanisms and examples.
Confirmed typed directional links retain configuration, effectivity, time, authority, provenance and status context.
Confirmed as-required, as-designed, as-planned, as-built, as-tested, as-delivered and as-maintained differences are preserved rather than overwritten.
Confirmed transformations and derived artifacts retain inputs, code/rules/tools/configuration, outputs, diagnostics, digests and staleness triggers.
Confirmed federated queries disclose missing, denied, unavailable, ambiguous, stale and incompatible sources.
Confirmed security applies to relationship traversal and inference as well as artifact content.
Confirmed every conclusion remains bounded by retrieved evidence and declared query context.
invariant_checking.notes: Connectivity, resolvability and provenance are necessary controls for the stated use, not sufficient evidence of engineering correctness.

proof_review.notes: The chapter presents an evidence argument and invariants but no theorem proof.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No passage is presented as a proof sketch.

evidence: The executable fixture labels its evidence synthetic_metadata_only and the surrounding text enumerates what it does not establish.
NASA, OMG, W3C and NIST sources are used for stated framework, API, provenance and interoperability concepts without claiming product conformance.
The chapter reports the published NIST integration limitation qualitatively and does not generalize it into a universal performance statistic.
Digital-thread health, twin fitness, signature/digest integrity and thread-supported conclusions are explicitly bounded.
No external review, operational deployment, supplier acceptance, safety finding, certification or product fitness is claimed.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Empirical statements distinguish the synthetic executable check, published source findings and proposed engineering practices.

conceptual_review.notes: Internal conceptual review checked digital thread, artifact state, typed link, authority, provenance, configuration, baseline/branch/commit, effective and record time, digital twin and thread health. Repository, integration bus, index, graph, data lake, thread and twin remain distinct.

practitioner_review.notes: Internal practitioner-oriented review checked use-case definition, authority mapping, identity issuance, predicate contracts, configuration/effectivity, lifecycle-state reconciliation, provenance, transformations, bitemporal history, federation, snapshots, APIs, mappings, link state, health measures, conformance testing, security, supplier boundaries, discrepancy closure and long-term preservation.

pedagogical_review.notes: Internal pedagogical review confirmed progression from definitions and decision need through architecture, semantics, evidence mechanisms, trade-offs and failure analysis. Ten examples isolate recurring defects; five complete solutions require thread design, architecture audit, supplier federation, configuration-aware change impact and honest legacy migration.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external NASA/NIST/OMG/W3C expert, configuration/data/provenance architect, API/platform operator, supplier, cybersecurity, privacy/export/data-rights, records-management, manufacturing, sustainment, digital-twin, assurance, independent V&V, certification, technical-authority or decision-authority review is claimed.
